plan.notes: Career Mobility (LPN-to-RN) 3-semester completion program from the official 2025-2026 Catalog Addendums (updated-programs section). NUR course credits are omitted in the 2025-2026 tables: NUR 209 = 10, NUR 211 = 7, NUR 221 = 7, confirmed by Bishop State's 2022-2023 catalog course descriptions and cross-validated by the printed semester totals (10/11/10). Seeded total_credits = 31 (sequenced sum only); the catalog's 'Total: 51 Credit Hours' adds 20 hours of general-education prerequisite coursework, recorded here as external_prereqs ('MTH 100 or higher' recorded as MTH 100; 'SPH 106 or SPH 107' recorded as first-listed SPH 106). BIO 220 and the Humanities Elective are marked '(if not already completed)' — kept in sequence as printed; Humanities Elective recorded as choice MUS 101 (first-listed of suggested MUS 101, ART 100, PHL 206). Upon successful completion of NUR 209 students are awarded 15 hours of non-traditional credit (base catalog lists 'NUR 999 - Mobility Credit 15 credits') — awarded credit, not sequenced. Admission also requires unencumbered Alabama LPN or paramedic licensure (not a course; excluded from external_prereqs). Seeded as program_type professional-phase (sub-4-term completion program), documented, not negative.
